name: Kunbarrasaurus
sum: Kunbarrasaurus is a small Early Cretaceous ankylosaur from Queensland, Australia, known from an almost complete skeleton with gut contents.
holotype: QM F1801, an almost complete skeleton — Allaru Formation, near Richmond, Queensland.
material: Holotype only; first referred to Minmi.
exceptional: Gut contents preserved in the abdominal cavity in front of the left ilium.
biology: Direct evidence of diet from the preserved gut contents.
author: Leahey et al. 2015
